scaffold.signature: createHotfixRuntimeInventory(root: string, commit: string, policy: HotfixRuntimePolicy): HotfixRuntimeInventory
scaffold.purpose: Trusted publisher builds complete proof; runtime must not manufacture or silently refresh it.
scaffold.policy: Explicit search scopes, root metadata files, excluded trees, entrypoints. Publisher must prove import/child/config coverage or refuse; passing a whitelist alone is not proof.

invariants: Compare two independently registered snapshots with identical runtime inputs; 24 extra evidence runs (72 JSON/log/docs files) add zero file operations, including traversal and metadata.
Excluded docs/evidence descendants receive zero read/traversal/metadata operations in each runtime-origin check.
Each guard rereads all runtime bytes; byte, executable mode, deletion and previous success do not defer refusal.
Cover source/entrypoint, lazy and dynamic import, child script, build/catalog, root/nested metadata, loaded dependency and unconventional .payload data.
New potential inputs in runtime scopes and package resolution refuse; symlink/hardlink and directory aliases refuse even with identical bytes.
Missing, wrong root/commit, incomplete scopes/files, unsupported inventory version refuse even when full activation fingerprint matches.
Retained reader validates its own physical generation while the registered current generation changes.
CLI/worker/service/hook/notice/runner-limits state preflight refuses mutations before creating state; existing SQLite/WAL/SHM sentinel bytes remain intact.
Builder must include all runtime inputs and reject unbounded or excluded import/child/package-config loads under the explicit policy.
Production full activation inventory still includes docs/evidence and changes digest or refuses on bytes/add/delete/mode/symlink/hardlink (12 passed tests).
unitBoundary: Synthetic trusted publication registry and mocked Git command port; real private filesystem fixture only. No live daemon, SQLite connection, tmux, runner, activation exchange or real Git subprocess. Existing state files are sentinel bytes for the pre-access invariant. Full activation tests use the production activation inventory/hash inputs, not a live publication gate.
